commands.name: search-shows
commands.summary: Fuzzy-search shows by name; returns scored matches with full show objects

commands.name: search-people
commands.summary: Fuzzy-search people (actors, crew) by name

commands.name: single-search-show
commands.summary: Return the single best-matching show for a name, optionally with embedded episodes, cast or other data

commands.name: lookup-show
commands.summary: Find a show by external ID (IMDb, TheTVDB or TVRage). Pass exactly one ID.

commands.name: get-show
commands.summary: Get a show's main details by TVmaze show ID, optionally with embedded cast or next/previous episode

commands.name: list-show-episodes
commands.summary: List all episodes of a show in airing order, optionally including specials

commands.name: get-episode-by-number
commands.summary: Get one episode of a show by season and episode number

commands.name: list-episodes-by-date
commands.summary: List a show's episodes that aired on a given date

commands.name: list-show-seasons
commands.summary: List a show's seasons with their season IDs, dates, episode counts and networks

commands.name: list-season-episodes
commands.summary: List the episodes of a season by its TVmaze season ID (from list-show-seasons)

commands.name: list-show-cast
commands.summary: List a show's main cast: each person with the character they play

commands.name: list-show-crew
commands.summary: List a show's crew (creators, producers and so on) with their crew type

commands.name: list-show-akas
commands.summary: List a show's alternate titles (AKAs) by country

commands.name: list-show-images
commands.summary: List a show's images (posters, banners, backgrounds) with their URLs

commands.name: list-shows
commands.summary: Page through the full show index, ordered by show ID (up to 250 shows per page)

commands.name: get-episode
commands.summary: Get an episode's details by episode ID, with its parent show embedded

commands.name: list-episode-guest-cast
commands.summary: List the guest cast of an episode: each person with the character they play

commands.name: get-person
commands.summary: Get a person's details (birthday, country, gender, image) by person ID

commands.name: list-person-cast-credits
commands.summary: List the shows a person was main cast in, with show details embedded

commands.name: list-person-crew-credits
commands.summary: List a person's crew credits (for example Creator or Executive Producer), with show details embedded

commands.name: list-person-guest-credits
commands.summary: List the episodes a person guest-starred in, with episode details embedded

commands.name: get-character
commands.summary: Get a character's details by character ID

commands.name: get-schedule
commands.summary: List the episodes airing on broadcast/cable TV in a country on a date, with show details

commands.name: get-web-schedule
commands.summary: List the episodes released on web/streaming channels on a date, optionally for one country

commands.name: list-show-updates
commands.summary: Get the shows updated in a recent time window, as a map of show ID to last-updated Unix timestamp
